training: Unmodified train.py --engine flat26 at scale 1 on the current simulator, using only its own randomly initialized and evolved weights and generic intermediate states. Store the model-selected winner before evaluation. No weights from other experiments enter the training or selection.
comparison: Evaluate the policy trained from random initialization from fresh model and native openings against W-tap, the retreating rival and the incumbent. Both seats and control arms.
